data.title: bn-3lbh: rite send --format json: git sync auto-commit output pollutes stdout

data.body: [severity:info] Failure-mode checklist. 1) Failure modes: git add or commit can fail, emit non-UTF-8 bytes, or invoke local hooks. Captured hook output can consume memory, but only same-user Git configuration can install that path. 2) Edge cases: missing repository, no-op commit, nonzero exit, spawn failure, JSON and text output, and hook output. Lossy conversion affects logs only. 3) Rollback: revert e6fa255. This restores inherited Git output and the known structured-output defect. 4) Monitoring: watch git add warnings, git commit spawn warnings, debug skip events, and rite sync status or log divergence. 5) Input validation: no new parser exists. Git receives argv directly. Channel names are validated. Staged paths are fixed or remain beneath channels/. No reportable security finding.

data.reason: Informational risk checklist complete; no reportable finding.
